# pulse_kv_entry (Resource)

One key in a KV bucket, for configuration that tools read from Pulse. A value changed outside Terraform (by a tool or the dashboard) is put back on the next apply. Destroying the resource deletes the key. Import with `<bucket>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pulse_kv_entry" "quiet_hours" {
  bucket = pulse_kv_bucket.settings.name
  key    = "notifications.quiet_hours"
  value  = jsonencode({ from = "22:00", to = "07:00" })
}

# Binary values are base64.
resource "pulse_kv_entry" "floor_plan" {
  bucket   = pulse_kv_bucket.settings.name
  key      = "maps.floor_plan"
  value    = filebase64("${path.module}/floor-plan.png")
  encoding = "base64"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) KV bucket name. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `key` (String) Key: letters, digits and `-/_=.` (dots separate levels, as in NATS subjects). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `value` (String) The value: text, or base64 when `encoding = "base64"` (use `base64encode()` or `filebase64()`).

### Optional

- `encoding` (String) `utf8` (default) or `base64`.
- `purge_on_destroy` (Boolean) On destroy, also drop the key's history (purge) instead of only writing a delete marker. Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<key>`.
- `revision` (Number) The key's revision after the last write.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pulse_kv_entry.quiet_hours home-settings/notifications.quiet_hours
```
